name: WALB daily XML sitemap (Arc)
covers: Every WALB article URL for a given date (swap in the date)
usefulness: Very high. The best backfill tool: pull every day of the year and grep for valdosta/lowndes + shoot/shot/killed. Found most of this list.
access: Free; HTTP 200 via curl. The /video/ URLs duplicate articles.
citedBefore: domain yes (WALB articles); the sitemap method is new

name: WCTV daily XML sitemap (Arc)
covers: Same as above for WCTV (Tallahassee; covers Lowndes)
usefulness: High; corroborates WALB and sometimes has stories WALB lacks
citedBefore: domain yes; the sitemap method is new

name: Valdosta Daily Times daily sitemap
usefulness: High. VDT republishes most VPD releases with dates, blocks, and charges
access: Free index; articles loaded via WebFetch (raw curl gets a JS shell). Some content may be metered.

name: Lanier County News (WordPress sitemap)
covers: Regional outlet that rewrites VPD/LCSO releases in English and Spanish
usefulness: Medium-high; carried the Old Hudson St robbery shooting and gives exact dates/times

name: Fox 49 (WFXL sister) local news
usefulness: Medium-high; often has the cleanest incident date/time

name: WTXL Lowndes County section
usefulness: Medium; corroboration, LCSO social-post quotes

name: WSAV crime & safety
covers: Savannah station that sometimes picks up Valdosta items
usefulness: Low-medium; corroboration only

name: Georgia Attorney General press releases
covers: Gang Prosecution Unit indictments (e.g., Remerton 2025 homicide indicted Aug 2026)
usefulness: Medium for follow-ups/outcomes; rarely first reports

name: Southern Judicial Circuit (DA / courts)
covers: Circuit court calendars and announcements; DA directory at lowndescounty.com
usefulness: Low for discovery; useful for case outcomes
access: Returned HTTP 202 (bot challenge); DA contact page: https://lowndescounty.com/m/directory/department?did=41

name: Lowndes County Odyssey court portal
usefulness: Medium for outcomes: search suspect names for agg assault/murder charges

name: re:SearchGA (Tyler)
usefulness: Medium for dispositions
access: Free account; documents may cost money

name: Lowndes County Sheriff - inmate search
usefulness: Medium: confirms arrest dates and charges (agg assault, murder)
access: Free; HTTP 200. Bookings don't prove someone was shot
citedBefore: domain yes; the inmate-search page is new

name: Lowndes County Coroner's Office
usefulness: Medium-high for fatal counts if you request them (manner/cause by month)
access: Open-records request (afiveash@lowndescounty.com, 229-375-6597). The /170/Coroner page showed a maintenance notice

name: Georgia DPH OASIS
covers: County-level firearm deaths and ER/hospital discharges by intent
usefulness: High for checking totals: gives the true count of Lowndes firearm injuries, not incident-level

name: CDC WISQARS
covers: National firearm injury/death data by county
usefulness: Medium for benchmarking; no incident detail
access: Free; lags; cdc.gov/injury returned 403 to curl

name: FBI Crime Data Explorer
covers: Agency-level NIBRS (VPD, LCSO) agg assault/homicide counts
usefulness: Medium for benchmarking annual totals
access: Free; JS app; lags a year

name: Gun Violence Archive incident query
covers: Incident-level US shootings, each with a source link
usefulness: High: filter by GA + city Valdosta; lists the May 3 travel center mass shooting
access: Free; query page works; results need a browser (JS/captcha possible)

name: The Trace
usefulness: Low for local discovery; useful context and data methods

name: Mapping Police Violence
usefulness: Medium for law-enforcement shootings (Sept 29 LCSO case)

name: Broadcastify - Lowndes County GA feeds
usefulness: Low: VPD/fire P25 talkgroups are encrypted per RadioReference; archives need a premium account

name: RadioReference - Lowndes P25 system
covers: Talkgroup list (shows which channels are encrypted)
usefulness: Low; tells you scanner coverage won't help much

name: VPD Facebook
usefulness: High, but the same releases reach Valdosta Today/VDT/Fox49 within days
access: Login wall for full browsing; loads (200)

name: LCSO Facebook
covers: Sheriff statements (county incidents often appear only here first)
usefulness: High for unincorporated county cases, which get less press

name: Lowndes County Fire Rescue Facebook
usefulness: Low

name: Nextdoor / Citizen app
usefulness: Low and unverified; leads only, never a source

name: Legacy.com Valdosta obituaries
usefulness: Low-medium: helps name victims and confirm deaths

name: Valdosta State University police (Clery ASFR / crime log)
covers: Campus crime log and annual report
usefulness: Low (no 2026 campus shootings found)
access: Log is in person or by openrecords@valdosta.edu; the online daily-log URL I guessed returned 404

name: Moody AFB news
usefulness: Very low

name: GPS press - Valdosta State Prison public record
usefulness: Low; prison violence is mostly stabbings, but worth checking for custody shootings

name: Lowndes County Schools
usefulness: Very low
